frequency_question: How often do national labor coalitions actually execute threatened indefinite strikes rather than settling or backing down prior to the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes formalized strike notices or strike authorization votes by national coalitions of sector-wide unions with explicitly stated indefinite timelines; excludes localized single-employer wildcat strikes or strictly limited one-day token strikes.
